name: A10-0290/2026 – Emma Ytterell – Article 14, after § 2 – Am 129
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on speeding-up environmental assessments
part_text: 2c. The classification of a project as strategically justified shall not in itself constitute approval of the project or a waiver of the obligation to carry out an environmental assessment required under Union law. The final decision on the approval of a project shall in all cases be explicit and reasoned. Member States shall ensure access to environmental information, effective public participation, and access to effective judicial remedies. Sections II and III of the Annex shall be applied in accordance with these guarantees and the respective requirements of national law.
